magnitude_analysis.pid_output_magnitude_Nm: up to 15 Nm (hip roll) or 30 Nm (hip pitch/knee)
magnitude_analysis.magnitude_ratio: PID is 25-50x larger than torque residual

root_cause_confirmed: Torque gains (k_roll=1.5, k_pitch=0.4) combined with max_ctrl_fraction (0.10-0.20) produce physical torques that are negligible compared to PID output. The PID controller saturates at ctrlrange limits while the torque residual has no measurable effect on robot behavior.
recommended_fix_directions: Option A: Increase torque gains by 10-50x (k_roll ~ 15-75, k_pitch ~ 4-20)
Option B: Reduce PID gains to allow torque residual to compete
Option C: Increase max_ctrl_fraction to 0.5-1.0 (but this may still be insufficient)
Option D: Switch to pure motor torque control (disable PID path)
